subject: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

Team — as part of the AWS + GCP marketplace listing refresh, we need to tighten our attribution + routing so we can answer:
1) which listing links drive signups / sales touches
2) how marketplace “purchases” map to HubSpot lifecycle + pipeline
3) how we capture the metadata Sales/SE keeps asking for (marketplace, SKU, offer/entitlement IDs, region)

Proposed approach:
- Add first-party redirect links for any URL we control in marketplace listings (docs, signup, “Contact Sales”). Those redirects set UTMs consistently and land on the canonical page.
- Normalize “marketplace activation events” from entitlement webhooks into HubSpot (at least company + deal association) so we can attribute revenue even if UTMs are missing.

I’ll draft a UTM taxonomy + HubSpot property spec today. Can you confirm which listing links we’ll have (AWS + GCP) + what CTAs we’re including?

Target: lock this by end of week so creative + docs can use the final URLs.

Ben
—
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing (Pipeline & Attribution)
Redwood Inference


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2026 at 10:01 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

Yes. Current plan for both listings:
- Primary CTA: “View documentation” (onboarding steps + FAQ)
- Secondary: “Contact Sales” (to our existing form)
- Support link: support page / troubleshooting guide

AWS listing lets us add multiple external links; GCP has slightly different formatting but we can still link out.

Also we’re adding a marketplace FAQ section in docs with the “buy via marketplace” path, so we’ll have a stable docs URL we can use.

Soojin


From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

+1. Let’s make sure whatever we do is durable — marketplace reviewers sometimes reject “tracking-y” links if it looks sketchy.

If we do redirects, they should be on redwood.ai and clearly map 1:1 (no interstitials).

Camila


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2026 at 1:47 PM
Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

Agree on “boring” redirects.

Proposal (examples):
- https://redwood.ai/marketplace/aws/docs  -> https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/aws?utm_source=aws_marketplace&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=marketplace_refresh_q1_2026&utm_content=docs
- https://redwood.ai/marketplace/aws/contact -> https://redwoodinference.com/contact?utm_source=aws_marketplace&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=marketplace_refresh_q1_2026&utm_content=contact_sales
- https://redwood.ai/marketplace/gcp/docs -> ...utm_source=gcp_marketplace...

UTM standard fields:
- utm_source: aws_marketplace | gcp_marketplace
- utm_medium: marketplace
- utm_campaign: marketplace_refresh_q1_2026 (we can roll this forward later)
- utm_content: docs | contact_sales | support | pricing

Non-UTM tracking (for actual purchase/activation):
- On entitlement webhook ingest, we should emit an internal event we can sync into HubSpot (company + deal fields). This matters because purchase flow often bypasses our web UTMs.

Attaching draft taxonomy + HubSpot properties spec.

Attachments:
- Marketplace_UTM_Taxonomy_v1.2.xlsx
- HubSpot_Marketplace_Properties_Spec_v0.9.docx

Ben


From: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2026 at 9:06 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

Ben — on the entitlement side, we can send a subset of fields to HubSpot once ENG-4401 is done.

Can you confirm the minimum set of fields you need so we don’t create a schema we can’t reliably populate?

Right now we have (or can have):
- provider: AWS | GCP
- provider_account_id (AWS payer acct / GCP billing acct — TBD naming)
- marketplace_product_code / sku_id
- entitlement_id
- org_id (Redwood)
- region (where entitlement was activated)
- activated_at timestamp

We probably cannot send end-customer PII from marketplace events beyond what they give us explicitly.

Talia


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2026 at 9:44 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

Minimum to make attribution + routing work:

Company-level properties (HubSpot):
1) marketplace_provider (AWS/GCP)
2) marketplace_account_id (string)
3) marketplace_first_activation_at (datetime)

Deal-level properties (HubSpot):
4) marketplace_entitlement_id (string)
5) marketplace_sku (string)
6) marketplace_region (string)
7) marketplace_status (enum: pending | active | canceled) — if we can keep it in sync

Lifecycle logic (high-level):
- If UTM indicates marketplace AND they submit Contact Sales -> standard inbound flow (create lead/contact), but set “Lead source = Cloud Marketplace”.
- If we receive entitlement activation (purchase) and there’s no existing open deal, create a deal in pipeline “Marketplace” and set lifecycle to SQL (or Opportunity) depending on Sales preference.
  - Markus: I’d like your take on whether “activated entitlement” should be SQL vs Opportunity.

Re PII: totally fine. This is mostly for routing + reporting + correlation. We can associate the entitlement to a company record via domain (if we have it), or via manual match by Sales/CS when needed.

Ben


From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 16, 2026 at 11:23 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

On lifecycle:
- Entitlement activation is a strong buying signal but it’s not always a “sales-led opportunity” (some are self-serve / <$10k).
- If we auto-create deals on every activation, the team will ignore them.

Suggestion:
- Create a deal on activation only if any of the following is true:
  a) SKU is Dedicated or Private
  b) contract value signal >= threshold (not sure we have this from marketplace?)
  c) they hit Contact Sales within N days
  d) domain matches an existing target account / open opp

Otherwise, set company property “Marketplace customer = true” and route to CS queue for onboarding assist (light touch).

Also, please capture “SKU family” (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) separate from “SKU name” so reporting doesn’t break when SKUs rename.

Markus


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 16, 2026 at 1:02 PM
Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

Makes sense.

Updated proposal:
- Always write company-level marketplace properties on activation.
- Deal creation conditional:
  - create Deal if sku_family in (Dedicated, Private)
  - OR if activation is followed by Contact Sales form submit within 14 days
  - OR if existing open Deal/target account match (we can implement as a HubSpot workflow / list)

Add fields:
- marketplace_sku_family (Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Add-on)
- marketplace_sku_name (string as listed)

Soojin/Camila: can we standardize the naming in copy so “sku_family” is stable across AWS/GCP? (Even if the marketplace SKU IDs differ.)

Ben

Subject: Re: Marketplace refresh: tracking + HubSpot routing (UTMs, lifecycle stages)

Approved on the approach + UTM standard.

Soojin will align listing naming to keep “Hosted / Dedicated / Private” consistent as the top-level taxonomy, with add-ons called out explicitly.

Talia — please ensure ENG captures sku_family in the entitlement mapping output (even if it’s derived from SKU ID mapping table).

Ben — once you set up the redirects, send me the final URLs so we can use them in the partner submission packets.

Camila

Camila Reyes
VP Marketing
Redwood Inference
